exercises.question: Which sentence describes a present/future hypothetical? [¿Cuál describe una situación hipotética presente/futura?]
options: Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría. [If I had more time, I would travel.]
Si hubiera tenido más tiempo, habría viajado. [If I had had more time, I would have travelled.]
Tengo más tiempo. [I have more time.]

exercises.sentence: Si ___ más información, habría decidido de otra manera. [If I had had more information, I would have decided differently.]
exercises.english: If I had had more information, I would have decided differently.
If things had been different, I would have accepted.

sentences: Primero, no tenía la oportunidad. [First, I did not have the opportunity.]
Después, me quedé con la primera opción. [Then I stayed with the first option.]
Finalmente, pensé: «Si hubiera tenido la oportunidad, habría elegido otra opción». [Finally, I thought: “If I had had the opportunity, I would have chosen another option.”]

exercises.question: Which sentence correctly describes a hypothetical consequence? [¿Cuál describe correctamente una consecuencia hipotética?]
options: Si cambiara el plan, ocurriría algo diferente. [If the plan changed, something different would happen.]
Si cambiaría el plan, ocurriría algo diferente. [If I would change the plan, something different would happen.]
Si cambié el plan, ocurriría algo diferente. [If I changed the plan, something different would happen.]

exercises.sentence: Si fuera posible, ___ otra alternativa. [If it were possible, I would choose another alternative.]
exercises.english: If it were possible, I would choose another alternative.
If I had taken another path, it would have been different.

exercises.question: Which sentence best integrates hypothetical language? [¿Cuál integra mejor el lenguaje hipotético?]
options: Si tuviera otra oportunidad, cambiaría mi decisión; si hubiera sabido más, habría elegido otra opción. [If I had another opportunity, I would change my decision; if I had known more, I would have chosen another option.]

Actualmente tengo una decisión importante que tomar sobre mi futuro profesional y necesito consultarlo con mi familia. [Currently I have an important decision to make regarding my professional future and need to consult it with my family.]

Ayer finalmente elegí una opción muy conveniente entre todas las alternativas disponibles después de comparar los costes. [Yesterday I finally chose a very convenient option among all the available alternatives after comparing costs.]
If I had more time, I would travel.
If I had had more time, I would have travelled.
I have more time and travel.

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera tenido más tiempo, habría viajado.
options: If I had had more time, I would have travelled.
If I had more time, I would travel.
I travelled because I had more time.

exercises.sentence: Si hubiera tomado otro camino, habría sido diferente.
exercises.english: If I had taken another path, things would have been different.

options: Elegiría otra. [I would choose another one.]
Elija otra. [I choose (subjunctive) another one.]
Haya elegido otra. [I have (subjunctive) chosen another one.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué habría pasado si hubieras tenido más tiempo?

options: Habría elegido otra opción. [I would have chosen another option.]
Habré elegido otra opción. [I will have chosen another option.]
Haya elegido otra opción. [I have (subjunctive) chosen another option.]
Elegiría otra alternativa. [I would choose another alternative.]
Elija otra alternativa. [I choose (subjunctive) another alternative.]
Haya elegido otra alternativa. [I have (subjunctive) chosen another alternative.]

exercises.question: Which sentence correctly contrasts the two hypothetical patterns? [¿Cuál contrasta correctamente los dos tipos de hipótesis?]
options: Si tuviera tiempo, viajaría; si hubiera tenido tiempo, habría viajado. [If I had time, I would travel; if I had had time, I would have travelled.]
Si tuviera tiempo, viajé; si hubiera tenido tiempo, habría viajado. [If I had time, I travelled; if I had had time, I would have travelled.]
Si tendría tiempo, viajaría; si habría tenido tiempo, habría viajado. [If I would have time, I would travel; if I would have had time, I would have travelled.]

template.prompt: Give a past hypothetical and its consequence.
template.answer: Si hubiera tenido más información, habría tomado otra decisión.
